description: The only capability: the main window. Native dialogs, reading/writing the files the user picked or dropped (plugin-fs scope is filled by the dialog plugin and the drop handler; no static paths), events, title-bar dragging, and the app's own commands. No shell, no HTTP plugin, no process. The only network access is the app's own sign_timestamp / sign_ocsp / sign_fetch_crl commands (http/https URL the user chose, no redirects, size cap, timeout) used when the user signs with a timestamp or long-term validation.
